{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|At least we don't have to live out of those rusting freighters anymore, though I'd swear these beds came out of an old L-class troopship.|[[Barga]]|<ref name="Flashpoint! Brak Sector">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>}}
The '''L-class troopship''' was a model of [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transports]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Barga]] believed that the triple bunks used for quarters in [[Oracle Base]] were salvaged from an L-class troopship.
